hero.title: GST invoice generator for Amazon sellers
hero.subtitle: Build a GST tax invoice with seller, buyer, and line items, then print or download.

intro: Fill seller and buyer details, add line items with HSN and GST rate, then print or save as PDF from your browser.

tips.title: HSN codes
tips.body: Use the HSN that matches your GST return filing for each SKU.

tips.title: Supply type
tips.body: Match IGST vs CGST/SGST to buyer delivery state.

tips.title: Print to PDF
